Demon Slayer – The Hinokami Chronicles – coming soon to Asia


SEGA will be publishing Demon Slayer – The Hinokami Chronicles, otherwise also known as Kimetsu no Yaiba: Hinokami Keppuutan, its Japanese name. Demon Slayer – The Hinokami Chronicles will be available on PS4, PS5, Steam, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X | S for Taiwan, Hong Kong, Korea and Southeast Asia sometime 2021. There will be Japanese and English voiceover, with subtitles in English, Japanese, Korean, and Traditional / Simplified Chinese.




You will be able to play through a Solo Mode that follows the anime, or Versus Mode where you can control one character and battle others. In Versus Mode, enjoy a simple but exhilarating battle system that allows up to two players. Choose two of your favourite characters for 2 vs 2 battles online or offline!



Related Posts   Pokemon Sleep Now Available In Malaysia   GamerBraves Newsletter Vol. 103 – The Glory of The Barbie/Oppenheimer Double Feature   Features of the game include:

Solo Mode: Follow Tanjiro through the anime story as he faces demons to turn Nezuko back into a human
Versus Mode: Match against each other in a 2 vs 2 setting with up to two players online or offline

Characters for versus mode include Tanjiro Kamado, Nezuko Kamado, Zenitsu Agatsuma, Inosuke Hashibira and Giyu Tomioka. More characters are scheduled to join the game, bringing their incredible skills and abilities, so stay tuned for more information. Characters planned to join the game include Sakonji Urokodaki, Sabito, Makomo, Shinobu Kocho, and Kyojuro Rengoku.

reference_summary: Demon Slayer - The Hinokami Chronicles, dikenali sebagai Kimetsu no Yaiba: Hinokami Keppuutan di Jepun, akan diterbitkan oleh SEGA di Asia untuk PS4, PS5, Steam, Xbox One dan Xbox Series S. Permainan ini akan mempunyai alih suara Jepun dan Inggeris, dengan sari kata dalam bahasa Inggeris, Jepun, Korea dan Cina Tradisional/Mudah. Ia akan menampilkan Mod Solo mengikuti cerita anime dan Mod Versus untuk sehingga 2 pemain. Watak termasuk Tanjiro Kamado, Nezuko Kamado, Zenitsu Agatsuma, Inosuke Hashibira dan Giyu Tomioka, dengan lebih banyak lagi yang akan ditambah. Permainan ini akan dikeluarkan pada tahun 2021 di Taiwan, Hong Kong, Korea dan Asia Tenggara.
